name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd.
about: ICICI Life Insurance Limited provides life insurance, annuity, pension, and health insurance products to individuals and groups in India. The company offers term, savings, unit linked, guaranteed return, child education, and retirement insurance plans; and pension fund management services. It distributes its products through individual and corporate agents, banks, and brokers, as well as through proprietary sales force (PSF) and online channels. The company was formerly known as ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company Limited and change its name to ICICI Life Insurance Limited in September 2026. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India. ICICI Life Insurance Limited is a subsidiary of ICICI Bank Limited.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~26% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~13% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 38 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 93), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 38 vs sector median 20; peers with similar ROE and growth trade nearer 17, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
